instrument: Reading zoning amendment limiting data centers to manufacturing districts
summary: Draft amendment would limit data centers to the Heavy Manufacturing and Manufacturing Commercial districts. The city's 180-day curative-amendment moratorium expires in January if the ordinance is not adopted first.

source.citation: Strisker Data Centers Weekly Briefing, Sept 21-24, 2026 (digest), citing local reporting (WFMZ)

notes: Planning Commission to consider the fourth draft Oct 20, 2026; draft sets a 5-acre minimum and setbacks of 500 ft (standard) and 1,000 ft (major) from a Preservation district; council adoption targeted for December; the 180-day application moratorium expires in January. Drafted by consultant Jerome Skrincosky (Hawk Valley Associates).

next.event: Reading Planning Commission vote on data center zoning amendment (fourth draft)
